name: Pyramids
overview: The Scriptures reference monumental structures such as desolate places built by kings and counselors, which may allude to the pyramids or similar ancient edifices (Job 3:14). In Isaiah 19:19, God promises a future altar and pillar in Egypt, signaling His sovereign presence amidst a land known for its grand monuments. While the Bible does not explicitly endorse these structures, it warns against pride and false exaltation, as seen in Ezekiel's rebuke of the prince of Tyrus who claimed divinity (Ezekiel 28:1-2) and Jesus’ condemnation of outward appearances masking inner corruption (Matthew 23:27). Ultimately, true authority and power belong to God alone, as acknowledged by those who recognize His miraculous works (John 3:2).
